about: Synthetic evidence for tuning's games, note and intent citations, which Hugh's staging decks barely reach (2 decks with games, 3 notes, no intent). Committed before any run. Injected in memory into the first six held-out decks' EvidencePack, in held-out order, and never written to a database or shown in the blind read. Notes are deliberately about the deck's play in general terms, so each reads plausibly for any commander.

decks.intent: A fast, focused build that wins before the table can answer.

games.note: Stuck on two lands until turn five.
Commander stuck around and took over.
No answer to the flyer that killed me.

decks.intent: Grindy value; I want to out-card the table over a long game.

games.note: One wrath and I never recovered.
Had the game locked but couldn't finish it.

decks.intent: Casual and a bit silly. Big splashy turns over efficiency.

games.note: Ran out of cards by turn six.

decks.intent: Control: answer everything, then win late.

games.note: Answered everything, then had no way to win.
Colour screwed: no second colour until turn six.
Engine online by turn four, nobody caught up.
Commander removed twice and I fell apart.
